controls.evidence: Anzens mints/burns USDA 1:1 against segregated USD reserves and Treasuries custodied at BitGo Trust, gated by KYC bank transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists on the Cardano native policy. On 2026-08-11, Koios policy_asset_list returned the single USDA asset under policy fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 with raw supply 4,452,382,510,000 at six decimals. A sampled mint transaction confirmed the PlutusV2 policy, an intent-spend script b09775cba66375b3287233c6f809036c066937d05254df82c2e4cfd3, and a reference datum containing key hashes b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358 and 57dc15b18a02c5ceedab40fc4c37dd4824a869983c7496c6e6516ba5. Koios returned no required_signers and no native script for either the mint or referenced setup transaction, so the datum alone does not establish which key authorizes minting, a threshold, or cap-changing power; canRaiseCap remains unknown rather than inferred.

review.evidence: Anzens (FinCEN MSB) is the sole issuer of USDA on Cardano; mint/redeem is centralized 1:1 via KYC bank transfers against BitGo Trust-custodied reserves. Policy ID fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456 is a PlutusV2 script. Independent Koios replay on 2026-08-11 inspected mint transaction 0450900785fa6608eb5f18b4f481939af82512f05b574bc8e5c3fdfea7d5f6fc: it minted 181.64 USDA, spent intent script b09775cba66375b3287233c6f809036c066937d05254df82c2e4cfd3, executed the USDA policy, and referenced b91c80748190c7280be0a41da2b80fd9690af6e174bca2e388476f8eea200b86#0. That reference datum contains key hashes b2136f4e7341a81ed5069cdf86f41a5e779498b6c97cab6496d1f358 and 57dc15b18a02c5ceedab40fc4c37dd4824a869983c7496c6e6516ba5 plus the intent and USDA policy identities. However, Koios exposed no required_signers field and no native script in either the mint transaction or reference-setup transaction. This confirms an intent/reference architecture but does not reproduce the claimed hot-signer semantics or cold 3-of-7 threshold; legal-entity-to-key attribution is also absent. Koios script_info confirms the policy was created in transaction 77f120599d05ed304970bb9bda15f2a8f56aa6495178065444c601f0212e675a with the USDA asset name embedded; Anzens/EMURGO publish custody-adjacent statements but no script parameterization or admin-control inventory. The public evidence still does not establish a hard supply ceiling or identify the authorization threshold, so authorityPosture, economicCapSemantics, and canRaiseCap remain unknown. Reconciliation also remains unknown: the claimed series is four image-only Medium-hosted examination posts in 16 months, newest period 2026-01-31 (about six months stale while supply fell materially), with no machine-readable report naming the firm, period, or opinion and no current transparency surface on anzens.com. A stalled, unverifiable series cannot support recurring-reconciliation credit. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: policy authorization and cap semantics remain unresolved, the examination series does not establish recurring reconciliation, and MSB registration is not prudential product supervision.
